tagline: Empowering consumers to express themselves freely through iconic beauty brands
hero_kpi_rationale: The fragrance segment represents over 65% of Coty's net revenue in fiscal 2025 and is a key driver of growth and profitability, supported by favorable structural tailwinds and expected expansion across price points and formats.

kpis.name: Fragrance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of fragrances
kpis.description: The fragrance segment is a key business area for Coty, representing over 65% of net revenue in fiscal 2025

kpis.name: Prestige Fragrance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of prestige fragrances
kpis.description: Prestige fragrance revenues increased at a low single-digit percentage rate in fiscal 2025, reflecting a deceleration compared to the prior year
kpis.signal: Decelerating growth in prestige fragrance market

kpis.name: Consumer Beauty Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of mass-market beauty products
kpis.description: The consumer beauty segment includes color cosmetics, body care, and mass fragrances

kpis.name: Skincare Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of skincare products
kpis.description: The skincare portfolio contributed mid-single-digit percentage growth to net revenue in fiscal 2025 and remains a strategic investment area

kpis.name: E-commerce Revenue
kpis.description: E-commerce is a key growth channel for Coty, expanding through online launches and digital commerce events

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin is expected to be under pressure in the first half of fiscal 2026 due to lower sales and the net impact of tariffs

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin is impacted by cost reduction initiatives and optimization of fixed cost structure

kpis.name: R&D Investment
kpis.explanation: R&D expenses as a percentage of revenue
kpis.description: R&D investments support innovation in fragrances, color cosmetics, and skincare

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Cash costs from the fixed cost reduction plan amount to approximately $80M, supporting supply chain re-optimization and manufacturing expansion in the United States
kpis.signal: Supply chain optimization and manufacturing expansion

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has a dedicated cybersecurity committee and external experts to assess risks, but this does not guarantee full protection against attacks

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The beauty market is highly competitive, with companies such as L'Oréal and Estée Lauder, which could affect Coty's market share

risks.title: Leverage
risks.score_rationale: Coty carries significant debt, which could limit its ability to invest in new projects and withstand financial difficulties

risks.title: Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Tariff increases could raise production costs by approximately $70M before mitigation measures. Coty estimates that $15-20M could be offset through non-tariff measures

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: A reputational crisis could harm Coty's brand image and impact sales

risks.title: Slowdown in China
risks.score_rationale: Coty's growth in China has slowed due to challenging economic conditions, affecting prestige product sales and travel retail channels

ai_positioning.summary: Coty has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from the 10-K/20-F filing.
